scoring_justification: Checker cannot re-run DFT; compare reported binding energies and bond lengths to paper-reported values with generous tolerances.

outputs.description: Binding energies and bond lengths for O adsorption on three Co3O4 surfaces, computed with PBE+U (relaxed) and HSE06 (single-point on PBE+U geometry). The checker will compare these values to paper-reported reference values with appropriate tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The task reproduces the low-coverage validation of PBE+U against HSE06 for three surface terminations. Coverage-dependent studies, vacancy formation, and reaction barriers are omitted (see plan).

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold binding energies and bond lengths for O on Co3O4(100)-A, (100)-B, (110)-A
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2 and textual descriptions (bond lengths: Co^t-O 1.64 Å, Co^o-O 1.84 Å, O-O^3o 1.39 Å, Co^t-Co^t bridge bond lengths from Fig. 4)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own reported DFT results; they serve as the reference the agent's reproduction must approximate.
